findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body: When multiple tenants share the database, a caller that supplies another tenant's known or guessed document ID can now retrieve that document because the query filters only on `documentId`. `getDocument` still receives `ctx.tenantId`, but this PR stops passing it and removes `{ tenantId }` from the lookup, so the authenticated tenant boundary must be restored.
